market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from 5%+ 10-year yield, oil spike, and Fed/Trump tension. Expect volatility into BOE decision and continued Treasury strength. AI names may stabilize post-sell-off but lack catalyst. Fuel inflation pressures consumer equities. Defense and energy outperform. Crypto weak on Clarity Act failure.
market_outlook.long_term: Global tightening (Fed, BOJ) supports USD and short-duration assets. AI capex cycle continues with government contracts as anchor. Oil supply diversification (Thailand, Indonesia E20) reduces Mideast dependency over time. India emerges as primary EM beneficiary. Data center energy demand creates utility/infrastructure tailwinds. US-China tech diplomacy via Trump-Xi could unlock cross-border investment.
